snippet.title: Fire & Light: Thrones of Tyberion - trailer 60 FPS (demo available on Steam)
snippet.description:
Fire & Light: Thrones of Tyberion is a fast-session rogue-survivor in which sitting on your throne allows you to reign over the battlefield. I document the creation of this game on a devlog on this Youtube Channel.

Kickstarter https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fireandlight/fire-and-light-thrones-of-tyberion

Presskit: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/2/folders/1eMElmJuowy2fEhZ3jCRsvPh0DVhtEeN0
